question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Someone who walks on foot
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Pedestrian"** means someone who walks on foot. (पैदल यात्री)

 
 
• **Example:** The pedestrian crossed the street at the crosswalk.
 
 
 
• **"Pedestrian"** refers to someone who travels by walking, usually on roads or pavements. (पैदल यात्री)
 
 
• **Example:** Pedestrians should always use the sidewalk for safety.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Auditor** (लेखापरीक्षक): A person who conducts an audit.

 
 
• **Example:** The auditor found several discrepancies in the financial report.
 
 
 
• **Decanter** (शराब की बोतल): A vessel used to hold the decantation of a liquid.
 
 
• **Example:** The waiter poured the wine from the decanter into the glasses.
 
 
 
• **Stalker** (पीछा करने वाला): A person who harasses or persecutes someone with unwanted and obsessive attention.
 
 
• **Example:** The celebrity had to get a restraining order against the stalker.
